Build pool + pointer parquets for one sample, from a subsetted msobject

Source: R/build_samples.R
build_parquets_xcms.Rd

The work behind process_xcms(stage = "sample"): looks up the sample's peaks for qualifying_features, widens their RT windows by rt_buffer, maps them to scans with extractScanInfo(), and calls Ms2PseudoRaw(). Writes nothing if the sample has no qualifying features or no matching scans.

Usage

build_parquets_xcms(
  mssubset,
  fd,
  out_dir,
  sample_id,
  qualifying_features,
  ppm = NULL,
  rt_buffer = 0
)

Arguments

mssubset

Output of subset_samples_xcms().

fd

featureDefinitions() table.

out_dir

Output directory (created if missing).

sample_id

Index into fileNames(mssubset$msobject).

qualifying_features

Feature ids to build for this sample.

ppm

MS1 tolerance in ppm, converted to Da at the largest feature m/z in this sample. NULL uses 0.005 Da.

rt_buffer

Seconds added to both sides of each peak's RT window.

Value

NULL.
